Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler that would run it refused my connection: the Gateway needs credentials for its cron service, and that's a setup change I shouldn't make from a chat request. Nothing is scheduled yet, so nothing will post on Monday 19 October unless it's fixed.

Once an admin has sorted the scheduler access, I can set it up. My plan:

- **Schedule:** every Monday at 08:00 America/Chicago, starting Monday 19 October.
- **Sources:** #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest won't reveal anything new to anyone.
- **Content:** last week's activity plus open customer items, posted here in #coastal-team.
- **Exclusions:** finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts, payment terms) stay out of the digest unless they've already been posted in these channels. Operational facts like seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers can go in.

Ruth or whoever runs the Gateway can check the cron credentials. Tell me when that's done and I'll create the job and run a test.
